package com.blockchain.contracts.storage

import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.Path
import java.nio.file.Paths
import java.nio.file.attribute.PosixFilePermissions
import java.security.SecureRandom
import javax.crypto.Cipher
import javax.crypto.spec.GCMParameterSpec
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec
import java.util.Base64
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap

data class ContractState(
    val contractId: String,
    val storageRoot: String,
    val encryptionKey: ByteArray,
    val nonce: Long
)

class EncryptedStorageEngine(private val baseDir: String) {
    private val stateCache = ConcurrentHashMap<String, ContractState>()
    private val GCM_TAG_LENGTH = 128
    private val GCM_IV_LENGTH = 12
    private val secureRandom = SecureRandom()

    fun initializeContract(contractId: String, masterKey: ByteArray): ContractState {
        val storageRoot = Paths.get(baseDir, "contracts", contractId).toString()
        Files.createDirectories(Paths.get(storageRoot))
        val state = ContractState(contractId, storageRoot, masterKey, 0L)
        stateCache[contractId] = state
        return state
    }

    fun executeStateTransition(
        contractId: String,
        transitionData: ByteArray,
        witnessProof: ByteArray
    ): ByteArray {
        val state = stateCache[contractId]
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("Contract not initialized")

        val intermediateState = computeIntermediate(state, transitionData)
        val serialized = serializeForCommit(intermediateState, witnessProof)

        val committedPath = commitToStorage(state, serialized)
        val encrypted = encryptStateData(state, Files.readAllBytes(committedPath))

        val finalPath = Paths.get(state.storageRoot, "state_${state.nonce}.enc")
        Files.write(finalPath, encrypted)
        Files.deleteIfExists(committedPath)

        stateCache[contractId] = state.copy(nonce = state.nonce + 1)
        return encrypted
    }

    private fun commitToStorage(state: ContractState, data: ByteArray): Path {
        val tempDir = System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir")
        val commitPrefix = "contract_${state.contractId}_commit_"
        val tempFile = File(tempDir, commitPrefix + state.nonce.toString())
        tempFile.writeBytes(data)
        return tempFile.toPath()
    }

    private fun computeIntermediate(
        state: ContractState,
        transitionData: ByteArray
    ): ByteArray {
        val combined = ByteArray(state.encryptionKey.size + transitionData.size)
        System.arraycopy(state.encryptionKey, 0, combined, 0, state.encryptionKey.size)
        System.arraycopy(transitionData, 0, combined, state.encryptionKey.size, transitionData.size)

        val digest = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        return digest.digest(combined)
    }

    private fun serializeForCommit(
        intermediateState: ByteArray,
        witnessProof: ByteArray
    ): ByteArray {
        val result = ByteArray(4 + intermediateState.size + 4 + witnessProof.size)
        val isLen = intermediateState.size
        result[0] = (isLen shr 24).toByte()
        result[1] = (isLen shr 16).toByte()
        result[2] = (isLen shr 8).toByte()
        result[3] = isLen.toByte()
        System.arraycopy(intermediateState, 0, result, 4, isLen)
        val wpLen = witnessProof.size
        result[4 + isLen] = (wpLen shr 24).toByte()
        result[4 + isLen + 1] = (wpLen shr 16).toByte()
        result[4 + isLen + 2] = (wpLen shr 8).toByte()
        result[4 + isLen + 3] = wpLen.toByte()
        System.arraycopy(witnessProof, 0, result, 4 + isLen + 4, wpLen)
        return result
    }

    private fun encryptStateData(state: ContractState, plaintext: ByteArray): ByteArray {
        val iv = ByteArray(GCM_IV_LENGTH)
        secureRandom.nextBytes(iv)

        val cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding")
        val keySpec = SecretKeySpec(state.encryptionKey, "AES")
        val gcmSpec = GCMParameterSpec(GCM_TAG_LENGTH, iv)
        cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, keySpec, gcmSpec)

        val ciphertext = cipher.doFinal(plaintext)
        val result = ByteArray(iv.size + ciphertext.size)
        System.arraycopy(iv, 0, result, 0, iv.size)
        System.arraycopy(ciphertext, 0, result, iv.size, ciphertext.size)
        return result
    }

    fun verifyStateIntegrity(contractId: String, stateIndex: Long): Boolean {
        val state = stateCache[contractId]
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("Contract not initialized")
        val statePath = Paths.get(state.storageRoot, "state_${stateIndex}.enc")
        if (!Files.exists(statePath)) return false

        return try {
            val encrypted = Files.readAllBytes(statePath)
            decryptStateData(state, encrypted)
            true
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            false
        }
    }

    private fun decryptStateData(state: ContractState, ciphertext: ByteArray): ByteArray {
        val iv = ciphertext.copyOfRange(0, GCM_IV_LENGTH)
        val encrypted = ciphertext.copyOfRange(GCM_IV_LENGTH, ciphertext.size)

        val cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding")
        val keySpec = SecretKeySpec(state.encryptionKey, "AES")
        val gcmSpec = GCMParameterSpec(GCM_TAG_LENGTH, iv)
        cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, keySpec, gcmSpec)

        return cipher.doFinal(encrypted)
    }
}
